MEASUREMENT.measured_serialization: json.dumps(instance, sort_keys=True) with ensure_ascii, the serialization Mission 1.84.4 measured as the maximum: every narrative character is U+1F600 escaped as a twelve-character surrogate pair.
MEASUREMENT.same_model_basis: proposition E_TOKENIZER_USED_BY_THE_COUNT: the request named claude-sonnet-5
MEASUREMENT.why_input_to_output_is_not_established: The count is of INPUT tokens for this text in a user message. No retrieved page states that the model spends the same number of OUTPUT tokens emitting the same object as a tool call, and a model need not emit the escaped form it was counted in: it could emit the raw character instead, or add tool-call framing the count never saw. Either direction is possible and neither is established.
MEASUREMENT.margin_note: The page says the count might differ by a small amount and quantifies nothing, so no documented margin exists to apply.

CAPACITY_COMPARISON.integer_reading: K read as one thousand, the reading under which the same pages write 1M tokens for the context window. It is also the smaller of the two possible readings, so any headroom computed from it errs toward too little, which is the safe direction.
CAPACITY_COMPARISON.adapter_default_is_not_a_capability: 4096 is this repository's AnthropicProvider default. It is kept distinct from the documented maximum, and neither was allowed to overwrite the other.
CAPACITY_COMPARISON.arithmetic_is_not_proof: An estimate compared with a ceiling is arithmetic. It is not evidence that a real output of this size would or would not fit, in either direction.
CAPACITY_COMPARISON.provider_max_is_not_an_execution_budget: 128000 is the most a single synchronous request may ask for. It is not a budget this repository has selected, and nothing here selects one.
CAPACITY_COMPARISON.why_the_batch_route_is_not_adopted: It is a different route: the Message Batches API behind a beta header, asynchronous, and outside the route the TED egress review and the provider posture assessed. Moving to it is an operator decision with its own review, not a consequence of arithmetic.

EMPIRICAL_RATIO_CROSS_CHECK.held_ratio_source: Mission 1.84's one measured pair, 12868 characters for 5967 tokens
EMPIRICAL_RATIO_CROSS_CHECK.note: Mission 1.84.3 classified the held ratio as a lower-information bound and warned that a ratio too high underestimates tokens. On this text it would have. Arithmetic, recorded to show the direction of the error; it is not used for anything.

THINKING.thinking_tokens_basis: Documented (propositions K and L) and the adapter's DISABLED body is tested. Not observed at runtime, because this mission sent no Messages API request.
THINKING.forced_tool_use_note: The define-tools restriction table names manual extended thinking and two other models, and neither is this configuration.

V1_THINKING_FINDING.basis: The adapter that ran V1 never emitted a thinking field, forced tool use works with adaptive thinking (M), a request without the field runs adaptive thinking on this model (J), and max_tokens caps thinking and answer together (L).
V1_THINKING_FINDING.why_not_established: Adaptive thinking decides per request, display defaults to omitted, and the V1 usage record was never retained, so whether and how much it thought is unknown.

STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.mechanism: forced tool use, no strict flag and no output_config

CEILING.why_none: A ceiling needs either a documented guarantee or a measurement plus an approved headroom policy. There is no documented margin, no approved policy, and the measured maximum is already larger than anything a synchronous request may ask for.

COST.why_not_computed: No MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS is selected, so there is nothing to price.
